title: A new account: trial, then purchase

steps.label:
Signs up.
Whole app open, meal planning included.

Last day of the trial.
Everything still open.

Trial over. Tapping the launcher
opens the paywall: buy or stop.

example: Signed up 1 Sep: trial runs 1 to 7 Sep, paywall from 8 Sep.
Buy: $9.99 a month or $69.99 a year. No free tier, no Pro tier.
